experiences.title: Marketing Analyst
experiences.description:
Built live GA4 and BigQuery dashboard tracking 500K daily active users, revenue, conversion funnel, and channel attribution with 5-minute refresh rate. Identified that mobile traffic was 62% of volume but only 34% of revenue, directing optimization efforts to high-intent segments.
Engineered automated anomaly detection system flagging traffic drops exceeding 15% or conversion spikes exceeding 25% per channel within 5 minutes. Reduced incident response time from 4 hours to 15 minutes, enabling faster paid media budget reallocation.
Analyzed 6-month dataset across 12 traffic sources and discovered email-sourced users had 4.1x higher repeat purchase rate versus paid search users. Informed email budget increase by $320K annually based on this finding.
Automated daily performance report delivery to 8 executives via Looker Studio with PDF exports. Replaced 90-minute manual Excel reporting with 10-minute automated refresh, freeing 7 hours per week for strategic analysis.
Implemented breakdown analysis by device, geography, and audience segment. Revealed iOS users converted at 2.3x rate of Android users. Recommended iOS-focused paid social budget shift with projected 18% incremental mobile revenue.
Built predictive revenue dashboard calculating daily run-rate projections versus monthly targets. Flagged 3 days in advance when pacing would miss forecast by over 5%, enabling real-time budget rebalancing and $180K revenue recovery.
Created drill-down capability from high-level KPIs to individual campaign performance. Discovered 3 underperforming Google Ads campaigns with CPA 28% above target. Prompted keyword pruning and bid adjustments yielding 16% CPA reduction.

experiences.title: Marketing Analyst
experiences.description:
Analyzed marketing performance across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and Email using SQL, Excel, and Power BI, identifying channel optimization opportunities that reduced Customer Acquisition Cost by 14% while improving qualified lead generation by 17%.
Developed RFM customer segmentation models using SQL for 6,500+ customer records, identifying high-value customer segments that generated 49% of total revenue and supporting targeted retention campaigns.
Conducted marketing funnel analysis across website visits, lead forms, MQLs, SQLs, and conversions, identifying a 42% drop off between MQL and SQL stages and recommending lead nurturing workflows projected to increase conversion rates by 11%.
Performed cohort retention analysis using SQL and Excel across 12 monthly cohorts, identifying engagement trends and recommending targeted campaigns that improved repeat customer engagement by 16%.
Built interactive Power BI dashboards tracking ROAS, CAC, CPL, CTR, Conversion Rate, and CLV, reducing manual reporting by 70% and enabling self-service analytics.
Automated campaign performance reporting using SQL and Power Query, reducing report generation time from 5 hours to under 1 hour while improving reporting accuracy.
